title: N-Queens II
statement: Return the number of ways to place n non-attacking queens on an n × n board (n ≤ 10).
hints: One queen per row: recurse on rows.
Track used columns and both diagonals (r − c and r + c) in sets or bitmasks.

solution.explanation: Choose the right granularity (one queen per row removes a whole dimension), and make the feasibility check O(1) with sets for columns and the two diagonal directions. The bitmask version (available = ~(cols | d1 | d2) & full, take the lowest bit) is the fast C++ classic.
